# TOOLS

<!-- Generated by `go run ./cmd/dumptools` from the tool registry. Do not edit by hand:
     tools.TestCatalogInSync fails when this file differs from the registry. -->

7 tools. Tool names are a contract: renaming one is a breaking change.

## `chat`

**Title:** Chat with the local model

Sends a conversation to the self-hosted Ollama model and returns the next assistant message. The server keeps no history: send the whole conversation in messages on every call. The answer ends with a [uso] line with the token counters.

Annotations: readOnlyHint=true destructiveHint=false idempotentHint=false openWorldHint=false

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "messages": {
      "description": "Conversation so far, oldest first.",
      "items": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "properties": {
          "content": {
            "description": "Message text.",
            "minLength": 1,
            "type": "string"
          },
          "role": {
            "description": "Message author.",
            "enum": [
              "system",
              "user",
              "assistant"
            ],
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "role",
          "content"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "type": "array"
    },
    "model": {
      "description": "Optional model name; must be one of the allowed models (see list_models); defaults to the server model (--model).",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "num_predict": {
      "description": "Maximum tokens to generate.",
      "maximum": 32768,
      "minimum": 1,
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "system": {
      "description": "Optional system instruction, placed before messages.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "temperature": {
      "description": "Sampling temperature, 0 to 2.",
      "maximum": 2,
      "minimum": 0,
      "type": "number"
    },
    "think": {
      "description": "Reason first: slower; for hard analysis. Default false.",
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "messages"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## `embed`

**Title:** Compute embeddings with the local embeddings model

Computes embeddings for one text or a batch with the dedicated embeddings model (--embed-model, never the generation model). By default it returns only a summary (count, dimensions, counters); set include_vectors for the numbers, limited to a few items. Batch texts: if the server keeps one model loaded, embed evicts the generation model (~25 s reload). The answer ends with a [uso] line with the counters.

Annotations: readOnlyHint=true destructiveHint=false idempotentHint=true openWorldHint=false

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "include_vectors": {
      "description": "Return the vectors too (at most 8 texts). Default false: summary only.",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "input": {
      "description": "One text, or a list of texts (batch).",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "description": "One text.",
          "minLength": 1,
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "description": "A batch of texts.",
          "items": {
            "description": "One text.",
            "minLength": 1,
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        }
      ]
    },
    "model": {
      "description": "Optional embeddings model; any model of the allowlist (--allowed-models); defaults to --embed-model.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "input"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## `extract`

**Title:** Extract information from a file with the local model

Extracts what the instruction asks from a text (UTF-8), .docx, .pptx, .pdf, .png or .jpg file read on the server, in the requested format. The file text never enters your context. Large files are split and merged automatically. The answer ends with a [uso] line.

Availability: registered only when the server starts with `--allow-root` (or `MCPOLLAMA_ALLOW_ROOT`); without it the tool does not exist and `tools/call` answers -32602.

Annotations: readOnlyHint=true destructiveHint=false idempotentHint=false openWorldHint=false

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "format": {
      "description": "Output format, e.g. a JSON array of {name, line} or a markdown table.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "instruction": {
      "description": "What to extract from the file.",
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "model": {
      "description": "Optional model name; must be one of the allowed models (see list_models); defaults to the server model (--model).",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "path": {
      "description": "Absolute path of a text (UTF-8), .docx, .pptx, .pdf, .png or .jpg file inside an allowed root; relative only when the server has a single root.",
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "think": {
      "description": "Reason first: slower; for hard analysis. Default false.",
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "path",
    "instruction"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## `generate`

**Title:** Generate text with the local model

Runs a single prompt on the self-hosted Ollama model and returns the answer. Use it to offload bulk mechanical work (drafts, rewrites, extraction) to the local model; no state is kept between calls. Counts and arithmetic are unreliable: ask for steps or a list and check outside. The answer ends with a [uso] line with the token counters.

Annotations: readOnlyHint=true destructiveHint=false idempotentHint=false openWorldHint=false

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "model": {
      "description": "Optional model name; must be one of the allowed models (see list_models); defaults to the server model (--model).",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "num_predict": {
      "description": "Maximum tokens to generate.",
      "maximum": 32768,
      "minimum": 1,
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "prompt": {
      "description": "The prompt text.",
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "system": {
      "description": "Optional system instruction.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "temperature": {
      "description": "Sampling temperature, 0 to 2.",
      "maximum": 2,
      "minimum": 0,
      "type": "number"
    },
    "think": {
      "description": "Reason first: slower; for hard analysis. Default false.",
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "prompt"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## `list_models`

**Title:** List installed and loaded models

Lists the allowed models (--allowed-models) installed and resident in VRAM, with the server defaults. A resident model outside the allowlist appears on a separate line (it takes VRAM; it cannot be used). It does not load any model and does not wait in the GPU queue.

Annotations: readOnlyHint=true destructiveHint=false idempotentHint=true openWorldHint=false

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {},
  "type": "object"
}
```

## `summarize_file`

**Title:** Summarize a file with the local model

Summarizes a text (UTF-8), .docx, .pptx, .pdf, .png or .jpg file read on the server; the file text never enters your context. Large files are split and combined automatically. The answer ends with a [uso] line.

Availability: registered only when the server starts with `--allow-root` (or `MCPOLLAMA_ALLOW_ROOT`); without it the tool does not exist and `tools/call` answers -32602.

Annotations: readOnlyHint=true destructiveHint=false idempotentHint=false openWorldHint=false

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "focus": {
      "description": "Optional: what the summary should emphasise.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "language": {
      "description": "Summary language; default Brazilian Portuguese.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "max_words": {
      "description": "Optional target length in words.",
      "maximum": 2000,
      "minimum": 20,
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "model": {
      "description": "Optional model name; must be one of the allowed models (see list_models); defaults to the server model (--model).",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "path": {
      "description": "Absolute path of a text (UTF-8), .docx, .pptx, .pdf, .png or .jpg file inside an allowed root; relative only when the server has a single root.",
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "think": {
      "description": "Reason first: slower; for hard analysis. Default false.",
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "path"

  "type": "object"
}
```

## `translate`

**Title:** Translate a file with the local model

Translates a text (UTF-8), .docx, .pptx, .pdf, .png or .jpg file read on the server; the file text never enters your context. Large files are translated part by part. The answer ends with a [uso] line.

Availability: registered only when the server starts with `--allow-root` (or `MCPOLLAMA_ALLOW_ROOT`); without it the tool does not exist and `tools/call` answers -32602.

Annotations: readOnlyHint=true destructiveHint=false idempotentHint=false openWorldHint=false

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "model": {
      "description": "Optional model name; must be one of the allowed models (see list_models); defaults to the server model (--model).",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "path": {
      "description": "Absolute path of a text (UTF-8), .docx, .pptx, .pdf, .png or .jpg file inside an allowed root; relative only when the server has a single root.",
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "target_language": {
      "description": "Language to translate into, e.g. English.",
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "think": {
      "description": "Reason first: slower; for hard analysis. Default false.",
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "path",
    "target_language"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```
